text_block_list.text:
Following the Kikuka Sho, Нарита Таисин
spends
her days in a listless melancholy,
shirking both
training and school—until
her spirits are stirred by
a basketball
game.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She realizes that the young, redheaded
player on
TV was the one who
confronted her before the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The girl tells of how she received the
courage to
never give up from a certain
person—someone
who is stronger than
anyone she knows.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And Уиннинг Тикит explains that Narita
Taishin's
strength to never back down
has always inspired
and encouraged her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All this time, I never lose faith in Narita
Taishin
and wait for her return every
day—until I finally
get the chance to
give her some heartfelt
encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She rediscovers her will to keep fighting
and vows
to make a comeback at the
Nikkei Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
